officialRevision: Usage and limits for Cloud Firestore

limits.officialText: Maximum number of databases per project: 100
limits.notes: Exact once multi-database management is implemented.

limits.officialText: Maximum number of CMEK-enabled databases per project: default 0, allowlist / support dependent
limits.notes: Not applicable to a local test daemon in 1.0; profile when the management API exists.

limits.officialText: Constraints on collection IDs: valid UTF-8 characters, no longer than 1,500 bytes, cannot contain a forward slash (/), cannot solely consist of a single period (.) or double periods (..), cannot match the regular expression __.*__
limits.notes: Implemented by ftd_core_types::ids::CollectionId. Local hardening: NUL and other control characters are rejected (INTENTIONAL_STRICTER).

limits.officialText: Maximum depth of subcollections: 100

Constraints on document IDs: valid UTF-8 characters, no longer than 1,500 bytes, cannot contain a forward slash (/), cannot solely consist of a single period (.) or double periods (..), cannot match the regular expression __.*__
limits.notes: Implemented by ftd_core_types::ids::DocumentId. Local hardening: NUL and other control characters are rejected (INTENTIONAL_STRICTER).

limits.officialText: Maximum size of a document name: 6 KiB
limits.notes: Measured on the UTF-8 bytes of the protocol resource name.

limits.officialText: Maximum size for a document: 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes)
limits.notes: Uses the official storage-size formula (spec 8.10.5).

limits.officialText: Constraints on field names: valid UTF-8 characters, cannot match the regular expression __.*__, maximum size of a field name 1,500 bytes
limits.notes: Implemented together with the field path parser.

limits.officialText: Maximum size of a field path: 1,500 bytes
limits.notes: Measured on the canonical field path representation.

limits.officialText: Maximum size of a field value: 1 MiB - 89 bytes (1,048,487 bytes)
Maximum depth of fields in a map or array: 20
limits.notes: Each map or array level adds one.

limits.officialText: Maximum API request size: 10 MiB
limits.notes: Measured on the message payload before protocol decode.

limits.officialText: Maximum time a transaction can run: 270 seconds
limits.notes: Logical clock in the deterministic profile, monotonic clock in compat.

limits.officialText: Maximum idle time for a transaction: 60 seconds
limits.notes: The idle deadline is refreshed on every transaction activity.

limits.officialText: Maximum number of field transformations that can be performed on a single document in a Commit operation or in a transaction: 500
Maximum number of composite indexes for a database: 200 (billing disabled), 1,000 (billing enabled); support may raise the limit
limits.notes: Override via FirestorePlanProfile::composite_index_limit_override.

limits.officialText: Maximum number of single-field configurations for a database: 200 (billing disabled), 1,000 (billing enabled)
limits.notes: An exemption and a TTL on the same field count as one configuration.

limits.officialText: Maximum number of index entries for each document: 40,000
limits.notes: Exact once the native index generator counts entries.

limits.officialText: Maximum number of fields in a composite index: 100
Maximum size of an index entry: 7.5 KiB
Maximum sum of the sizes of a document's index entries: 8 MiB
limits.notes: Sum over all single-field and composite index entries.

limits.officialText: Maximum size of an indexed field value: 1,500 bytes; values over 1,500 bytes are truncated in the index
limits.notes: Production truncates the indexed representation; do not replace with a plain rejection.

limits.officialText: Maximum number of export and import requests for a project allowed per minute: 20
limits.notes: Sliding window, not token bucket, once the API exists.

limits.officialText: Maximum number of concurrent exports and imports: 50
Maximum number of collection ID filters for export and import requests: 100
Free quota, stored data: 1 GiB
limits.notes: Free tier applies to one database per project; observed only by default.

limits.officialText: Free quota, document reads: 50,000 per day
limits.notes: Daily reset at Pacific-time midnight via the timezone adapter.

limits.officialText: Free quota, document writes: 20,000 per day
Free quota, document deletes: 20,000 per day
Free quota, outbound data transfer: 10 GiB per month
